summary: StreamProof 2.0 (OBS Game Capture & Performance), Rotation & PearlCatch Fix, Split-Inspector Cloud Configs, Safe XBow & Memory String Hygiene

changes.title: Silent Rotation, AimAssist & PearlCatch Fixed
changes.detail: Resolved bytecode unary-negation corruption that caused AimAssist Smooth/Natural modes to lock onto sky/ground and prevented PearlCatch from solving and firing wind charges; hardened PearlCatch retry & instant throw paths

changes.title: StreamProof 2.0 (OBS Game Capture & Smart Idle Bypass)
changes.detail: Zero-SwapBuffers Win32 layered presentation hides overlays from OBS Game Capture and Display Capture in borderless fullscreen, adds Smart Idle Bypass (0 ms idle cost), cached LibFFI calls, and a StreamProof FPS cap (60/120/Uncapped)

changes.title: Split-Inspector Cloud Configs & Background Media Polish
changes.detail: Redesigned Cloud Configs browser with category filters, live included-module inspector, Refresh/Update controls, plus Ctrl+V paste, inline Browse/Clear, and full PNG/JPG/GIF/MP4 support for ClickGUI background media

changes.title: Safe XBow & Runtime Memory String Hygiene
changes.detail: Added XBow Safe mode with Slab Delay (bottom slabs only after firing), eliminated static runtime string caches & StringConcatFactory leaks, and tightened SelfDestruct direct cleanup
